g.text: 20% and 70% of episodes end in a fall

g.text: The same delayed filter is the best scheme tested at 0.5 m/s and falls in a fifth of episodes at 1.0 m/s.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: Evaluating a smoothing filter only at low speed records it as a success and then fails on deployment.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: On the policy trained without effort terms the delayed scheme falls in 37% of episodes overall, and in every episode at 1.0 m/s.
